args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

The function parseAmount in src/util/money.ts strips some currency symbols like €$£¥ from amounts but does not handle other currency symbols such as ₹ or CHF. This causes amounts starting with those symbols to fail parsing, explaining the issue with Indian subsidiary bank import failing on amounts like '₹1,250.00'.
